steps.title: Choose the brand
steps.detail: Pick the manufacturer you are shopping for. Their site opens in a new tab, and this page stays open behind it.

steps.title: Copy the appliance link
steps.detail: On their site, copy the link to the appliance you want, then paste it into the enquiry box.

steps.title: Fill in your details
steps.detail: Your name, phone, email and where you are. Then we price it and reply.

home.title: Appliance, TV and audio quotes by email
home.description: Choose any appliance, television or audio product on the manufacturer’s own website, send us the model, and we will email you a price within 24 hours.

hero.headline: Fast delivery isn't an upgrade. It's our standard.
hero.process: Choose your appliance on the manufacturer's website, send us the model number, and we will email you a quote within 24 hours.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.intro: We do not sell online. You choose the exact appliance on the manufacturer’s own website, send us the model, and we come back with a price.

about.heading: About us
about.body: We are an independent electrical retailer covering the major appliance, television and audio brands. We do not list prices online — every enquiry is quoted by hand.
about.credentials: Every enquiry is priced by a person who knows the range, so you can ask about anything a manufacturer makes — not only the models that happen to be listed on a website.

repairs.heading: We also repair
repairs.body: Bring your item in to our counter in Edgware and we will find out what is wrong with it. Telling you what it needs, and what it would cost, is free — you decide once you know.
repairs.workshop: Repairs are carried out on Saturdays. You can drop your item off on any day we are open.

order.title: Request a quote
order.description: Pick a brand, send us the model number or a link from the manufacturer’s website, and add your details. We reply to every enquiry within 24 hours.

step1.heading: Choose a brand
step1.intro: Most of this happens on the manufacturer’s own website — you come back here with the link to the appliance you want.
step1.skip: Already have a model number? Skip to step 2

step2.heading: Add your appliance
step2.intro: On the manufacturer’s site, open the appliance you want and copy the link from your browser’s address bar. Paste it below and we will work out the model from it.
step2.alternatives: No link to hand? The model number from the product page is enough on its own — and if you have not settled on a model yet, describe what you are after instead.
step2.describeSummary: Not sure — describe what you’re after
step2.describeLabel: Tell us what you’re looking for
step2.describePlaceholder: A quiet integrated dishwasher, ideally within 60cm

step3.heading: Your details
step3.intro: Four short questions — everything we need to price your enquiry and get back to you. You can change any answer before you send it.

name.question: What name should we put on the quote?
name.label: Your name

phone.question: What is the best number to reach you on?
phone.label: Phone number

email.question: Where should we send the quote?
email.label: Email address

step3.consent: I agree to my details being used to reply to this enquiry.

submit.retrying: Still trying — this can take a few seconds.
submit.failureHeading: We could not send your enquiry
submit.failureBody: Nothing has been lost. Your enquiry is saved on this device and we will keep trying to send it.
submit.blockedHeading: We could not accept that from this browser
submit.blockedBody: This can happen with some browser extensions and automated tools. Try again, or send your enquiry to us directly.
submit.limitHeading: That is several enquiries from this device
submit.limitBody: We have not sent this one. If it is a separate enquiry, send it to us directly and we will pick it up with the others.
submit.whatsappNote: This opens WhatsApp with your enquiry already written out.

step4.heading: Enquiry sent
step4.referenceNote: Quote this if you get in touch before we reply.
step4.whatsappNote: Useful if you want to send us a screenshot of the appliance.
step4.whatsappPrefill: I have just sent an enquiry through your website. My reference is
step4.intro: That is everything we need. Your enquiry is with us and nothing further is needed from you.

repairs.title: Repairs
repairs.description: We repair televisions, audio and DJ equipment, microwaves and smartphones. Bring your item to our counter in Edgware for a free estimate — you decide what to do once you know what it needs.
repairs.heading: Book a repair drop-off

step1.heading: What needs repairing?
step1.intro: Choose the closest match, then tell us what the item is.
step1.productPlaceholder: Samsung 55-inch OLED television, about four years old
step1.productHint: The make, model and rough age if you know them. A guess is fine.
step1.excludedNote: If your item is one of these we cannot take it on. We would rather tell you now than after you have filled in a form.
step1.otherBody: Tell us what it is below and we will let you know whether we can help. If you would rather ask first, message us on WhatsApp.

step2.heading: What is wrong with it?
step2.intro: In your own words — whatever you can tell us helps us start in the right place.
step2.faultPlaceholder: No picture, but the standby light comes on and I can still hear sound.
step2.estimateBody: We look at your item, find out what it needs, and tell you what it would cost. Nothing is repaired and nothing is charged until you have agreed the price.

step3.heading: Your details and drop-off
step3.intro: Three short questions, then when you plan to bring it in.

name.question: What name should we put on the job?
name.label: Your name

phone.question: What is the best number to reach you on?
phone.label: Phone number

step3.slotHeading: When will you bring it in?
step3.slotIntro: You do not need an appointment. This only tells us to expect you, so your item is booked in the moment it arrives.
step3.slotNone: There are no drop-off times available at the moment. Call us and we will sort something out.
step3.consent: I agree to my details being used to reply to this repair enquiry.

step4.heading: Repair enquiry sent
step4.intro: We have your details. Bring your item to the counter at the time you chose and we will book it in.
step4.referenceNote: Quote this if you get in touch about the repair.
step4.bringNote: The item itself, and anything that came with it that might be part of the fault — the remote, the power supply, the cable. If you have a printed slip it helps us match your item to your details, but it is not essential.
step4.whatsappNote: Useful if you want to send us a photograph of the fault.
step4.whatsappPrefill: I have just sent a repair enquiry through your website. My reference is

submit.retrying: Still trying — this can take a few seconds.
submit.failureHeading: We could not send your repair enquiry
submit.failureBody: Nothing has been lost. It is saved on this device and we will try again next time you open the page. You can also send it straight to us on WhatsApp, or simply bring the item in and give us your name at the counter.
submit.blockedHeading: We could not accept that from this browser
submit.blockedBody: This can happen with some browser extensions and automated tools. Try again, or send it to us on WhatsApp.
submit.limitHeading: That is several enquiries from this device
submit.limitBody: We have not sent this one. If it is a separate repair, send it to us on WhatsApp and we will pick it up.
submit.whatsappNote: This opens WhatsApp with your repair enquiry already written out.

dropoff.heading: Where to bring it
dropoff.workshopNote: Repairs are carried out on Saturdays. You can drop your item off on any day we are open.

label.title: Repair drop-off slip
label.description: A printable A4 slip for a repair booked through the website.
label.heading: Repair drop-off slip
label.emptyBody: A drop-off slip is built entirely from the link that opens it, so a link that has been cut short — by an email client wrapping it, usually — cannot be rebuilt. Open the original link again, or copy it in full into the address bar.

footer.note: All brand names and logos are the trademarks of their respective owners. We confirm every model, price and delivery date by email before an order is placed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: That page does not exist. Start a quote enquiry or return to the home page.
notFound.heading: That page does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or we may have moved the page. Nothing is wrong with your enquiry — anything you had saved is still here.
